article_type: definition and how-to guide with worked example
search_intent: Definition plus how-to (what swarming is, when and how to do it), with secondary comparison (pairing/mobbing) and troubleshooting intent
h1: Agile Swarming: What It Is, When to Swarm and How
seo_title: Agile Swarming: What It Is, When to Swarm and How
meta_description: Agile swarming explained: how it works, when to swarm and when not to, swarming vs pairing and mobbing, a worked Sprint example and common mistakes.
excerpt: What agile swarming is, where the idea comes from, why it works (Little's Law, earlier Done, fewer handoffs), when not to swarm, how to run it day to day, and a worked Sprint example that shows both the coordination cost and the reduced risk of unfinished work.
parent_topic_cluster: /project-management/agile/ (Agile practices; linked to the Kanban flow cluster)
learning_objectives: Define agile swarming and distinguish it from pairing, mob/ensemble programming, incident swarming and Intelligent Swarming
Explain what the Scrum Guide and Kanban Guide do and do not say about swarming
Explain the mechanisms (Little's Law, earlier Done, fewer handoffs, shared knowledge) and the coordination cost
Decide when to swarm, when not to and how many people to involve
Run swarming through Sprint Planning, WIP limits and a right-to-left Daily Scrum, and measure whether it helps
